description: This file defines the Customer model class for the OpenCart admin module, including methods for CRUD operations on customer data, addresses, histories, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, tokens, and associated entities in the database.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: This class handles all customer-related database operations, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving customer information, addresses, histories, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, and tokens. It serves as the data access layer within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database with provided data, returning the new customer ID.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by customer ID with new data.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Sets the commenter status for a customer account.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer and all related data such as activities, addresses, histories, rewards, transactions, wishlists, IPs, authorizations, and associated models.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer data by customer ID, decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches customer data by email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Returns a list of customers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Returns count of customers within a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Removes all activity logs associated with a customer.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer and optionally sets it as default.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an address record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address records for a customer, optionally by address ID.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed address information with related country, zone, and address format info.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Fetches all addresses for a customer, including country and zone details.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns total addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts addresses by country.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts addresses by zone.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a customer history comment.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history logs for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves customer history entries with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Removes all wishlist entries for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes wishlist entries associated with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByProductId
methods.description: Removes wishlist entries associated with a specific product.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Records a new transaction for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Removes all transactions for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transactions related to a specific order.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Counts total transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates total sum of transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts transactions by order ID.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes all reward points for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward entries associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Fetches reward entries for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Counts total reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Sums up total reward points for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts reward entries for an order.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Removes IP logs for a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP logs for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts IP logs for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Counts customers associated with an IP address.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempts information for an email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Deletes login attempt logs for an email.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes customer authorization records.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the authorization attempts for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Fetches authorization record by ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization info for a customer based on token.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Lists authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a token for a customer with type and code.

methods.name: deleteTokens
methods.description: Deletes all tokens associated with a customer.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record by its code.
